facts.fact: Kayla 抢在 Clay 之前表态：朋友需要帮助时她不会坐在家里
facts.anchor: And I won’t sit at home while my friend needs help

facts.fact: Kayla 隔门告知身份与来意，给 Vero 不开门的选项，再坐下等待
facts.anchor: If you don’t want to let me in, I can just sit here

facts.fact: Vero 发作时拔扯自己的头发，痛到不得不用剪刀剪掉
facts.anchor: I couldn’t stop pulling it, so I had to cut it off

facts.fact: Kayla 拒绝扮演修复者，只承诺陪伴到 Vero 准备好
facts.anchor: I’m not going to fix it, but I will sit here with you until you are ready to move

facts.fact: Clay 解释拳台对打是 Vero 走出脑内噪音的既有方式，Kayla 被迫旁观
facts.anchor: this is how Vero gets out of his head when nothing else works

facts.fact: 浴室里 Vero 以掌根撞击头部，Kayla 抓住他的手腕求他说话
facts.anchor: I reach out and catch his wrist before he hits himself a third time

facts.fact: Vero 先否认爱意随即改口，坦承爱 Brawley 爱到无法思考
facts.anchor: I’m not in love with you

facts.fact: Kayla 回应：她能预见自己会爱 Vero，但不会以 Brawley 的方式，也不与之竞争
facts.anchor: I would never love you the same way Brawley does
